claims.claim_text: Vertex generated $12.0 billion in total revenues in 2025, up from $11.0 billion in 2024, primarily from CF franchise (TRIKAFTA/KAFTRIO, ALYFTREK, SYMDEKO, ORKAMBI, KALYDECO) with additional contributions from CASGEVY and JOURNAVX launches.
claims.subject: VRTX
claims.source_quote: In 2025, our total revenues increased to $12.0 billion as compared to $11.0 billion in 2024

claims.claim_text: CASGEVY (exagamglogene autotemcel), Vertex's ex-vivo CRISPR/Cas9-based gene-editing therapy for severe SCD and TDT, is approved in the U.S., EU, U.K., Canada, Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, Qatar, UAE, Kuwait, and Switzerland; 64 patients received infusions in 2025 generating $115.8 million in product revenue.
claims.subject: VRTX
claims.object_value: CASGEVY approved across 10+ jurisdictions, 64 infusions in 2025, $115.8M revenue
claims.source_quote: CASGEVY, our ex-vivo, non-viral CRISPR/Cas9-based gene-editing therapy for severe SCD and TDT, is approved in the U.S. and across multiple geographies... In 2025, we recorded $115.8 million of CASGEVY product revenues. This reflects 64 patients receiving infusions of CASGEVY in 2025

claims.claim_text: JOURNAVX (suzetrigine), a first-in-class oral selective NaV1.8 inhibitor for moderate-to-severe acute pain, was approved by the FDA in January 2025; more than 550,000 prescriptions were written through year-end 2025.
claims.subject: VRTX
claims.source_quote: JOURNAVX was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration ( FDA ) in January 2025 for the treatment of moderate-to-severe acute pain in adults. Since JOURNAVX became available at U.S. pharmacies in March 2025 and through the end of 2025, more than 550,000 prescriptions were written and filled

claims.claim_text: Vertex completed enrollment in the Phase 3 trial of povetacicept for IgA nephropathy in 2025 and initiated rolling BLA filing in Q4 2025 with U.S. accelerated approval submission expected in H1 2026; trial is registered on clinicaltrials.gov.
claims.subject: VRTX
claims.predicate: has Phase 3 trial in IgA nephropathy with BLA initiated
claims.object_value: povetacicept Phase 3 IgAN enrollment complete; rolling BLA started Q4 2025
claims.source_quote: We completed enrollment in the Phase 3 clinical trial evaluating povetacicept for IgAN and, in the fourth quarter of 2025, we initiated the rolling Biologics Licensing Application ( BLA ) filing for U.S. accelerated approval with submission of the first module.

claims.claim_text: Vertex has multiple pivotal-stage clinical programs including inaxaplin (Phase 2/3 in AMKD - AMPLITUDE), zimislecel (Phase 1/2/3 in T1D), and suzetrigine (two Phase 3 trials in diabetic peripheral neuropathy).
claims.subject: VRTX
claims.object_value: inaxaplin AMPLITUDE P2/3 enrollment complete (interim cohort); zimislecel P1/2/3 enrollment complete (dosing postponed); suzetrigine P3 DPN x2
claims.source_quote: We have completed the enrollment of the interim analysis cohort of the Phase 2/3 clinical trial ... We have completed enrollment in the Phase 1/2/3 clinical trial of zimislecel ... We are evaluating suzetrigine for the treatment of DPN in two Phase 3 clinical trials

claims.claim_text: Vertex collaborates with Lonza to build a 130,000 sq ft dedicated manufacturing facility in New Hampshire for T1D cell therapy (zimislecel) production, with lease payments starting Q1 2026.
claims.subject: VRTX
claims.object_value: 130,000 sq ft NH facility, lease payments begin Q1 2026, operated by Lonza
claims.source_quote: we have a strategic agreement with Lonza to support the manufacture of T1D cell therapy product candidates, pursuant to which we have partnered with Lonza to build a 130,000 square foot dedicated new facility operated by Lonza in New Hampshire

claims.claim_text: Vertex acquired Alpine Immune Sciences in 2024, accounted for as an asset acquisition that drove a $4.4 billion AIPR&D charge in 2024; this acquisition established the povetacicept renal program.
claims.subject: VRTX
claims.object_value: Alpine acquired in 2024; $4.4B AIPR&D charge; produced povetacicept (IgAN, pMN)
claims.source_quote: In 2024, AIPR&D included $4.4 billion resulting from our acquisition of Alpine Immune Sciences, Inc. ( Alpine ), which was accounted for as an asset acquisition.
